description: Every API one provider publishes, as a page you can filter — the provider's own catalog rather than the whole network's. Prefer this over find_apis with a `providers` filter when you already know the company: it is the endpoint the provider page itself is built from, so `meta.total` is that provider's real API count. Filter by `tags` (with `match`), require `artifact_types`, or pass include=["content"] to inline artifact bodies.

artifact_types.description: Only APIs carrying these artifact types, e.g. ["OpenAPI"].

context.description: Optional: one sentence on why you are asking. Never used to rank; read only if a result is wrong.

include.description: Pass ["content"] to inline each artifact's body instead of just its URL.

slug.description: Provider slug — lowercase, hyphenated, as find_providers returns it, e.g. "stripe".

tags.description: Tag slugs, e.g. ["payments"]. On providers: what the company does (see api_tags).

name: get_provider_apis
